messages:
morgan: Drafting a proposal: per-request provenance + configurable field-level redaction for sampled logs. TL;DR: make sampled logs useful for debugging while minimizing PII exposure. PTAL.
asha: Can you sketch the provenance token? how does it tie to sampling and RBAC?
devon: Quick caveat: we must avoid anything that makes tokens reversible. also perf budget on token generation.
morgan: Plan: attach short HMAC token (sha256 truncated) + route/model/version + sample_type (audit|debug|metrics). Token not reversible; used for traceability in console and for correlating across systems.
devon: Concern: HMAC still links to tenant id if we include it. Use tenant-specific salt rotated monthly?
morgan: Yes — salt per-tenant stored in KMS, rotated by job. Server-side only; console shows salted token. Add an allowlist for legal/audit to map back.
liam: How about redaction granularity? full-mask vs partial-mask vs pseudonymize.
asha: Suggest levels: NONE, MASK (xxx), PSEUDO (consistent hash), BLANK. Default MASK for text fields, PSEUDO for identifiers, NONE only for audit mode.
samir: Can we plumb this through existing sampling? e.g., sample_rate per-route and override when route flagged high-sensitivity.
morgan: Yes: sampling hierarchy: global default, per-tenant, per-route override. Also allow emergency 'inspect' canary toggle with breakglass that requires two-person auth.
sre-alex: Ops: need SLA for inspect toggles. Also quota impact — storing sampled payloads increases DS cost. Rough estimate: 10k samples/day => 20GB/month.
liam: Console UX: show redaction level on each sample and a button 'request unredact (legal)' that creates ticket with SSO and justification.
asha: Implementation: pipeline stages — 1) extractor heuristics (email/ssn/credit) 2) per-field policy 3) provenance attach 4) store to blobstore + metadata to events db.
devon: Extractor false positives will hurt debugging. Need allowlist + dry-run for 2 weeks where we tag suspected fields but don't redact.
morgan: Agree — plan: dry-run mode for 14 days in staging then limited canary. We'll log counts to telemetry dashboard: redact_rate, false_pos_estimate, sample_store_bytes.
samir: Telemetry: make a dashboard per-tenant with these metrics + cost projection and top routes by leakage score.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary feature flag created: provenance-redact-v1.0 -> env=staging
liam: One more: embeddings. We shouldn't store raw embeddings tied to user text. Default: do not store embeddings, only hashed fingerprint + metadata.
morgan: Noted. I'll update the RFC with these specifics and add the console mockups. Who can review the heuristics proto? @asha @devon
asha: I'll take heuristics proto next week.
devon: I'll review storages + KMS integration.
samir: Add me for telemetry binding.
morgan: :thumbsup: moving to RFC stage.
